tools.purpose: Inspect, convert and assemble audio/video; compare with graphical editors for the actual task.
tools.control: CLI; inspect streams and render a separate output, then verify duration, video frames and audio.

tools.purpose: Generate images and video from model workflows; complements deterministic titles and editing.
tools.control: Local API. Inspect installed nodes/models and an API-format workflow before submitting a job; verify generated media. Do not assume a saved UI workflow is an executable API prompt.
Named-pipe scripting when mod-script-pipe is enabled and Audacity is running; otherwise supported UI control. Verify the exported audio, not just a command acknowledgement.

tools.purpose: Optional local model service; compare model quality and hardware cost with the funded cloud agents for each task.
tools.control: Use a configured local API only after checking the server and loaded model. Finding the desktop app does not mean a model is running.

tools.purpose: Video editing and finishing; a folder of exported videos does not prove the editor is installed.
tools.control: Check the actual editor installation and supported scripting interface or UI. Preserve the original project and verify a rendered preview.

tools.purpose: Candidate for timestamped transcription and subtitles, not an audio editor or automatic replacement for live dictation.
tools.control: CLI/Python through a known installation. Compare name/number accuracy and silent-audio behavior on representative input before adoption; review the transcript.

tools.purpose: Candidate for reproducible animated titles, artwork overlays and captions; compare with existing editing workflows.
tools.control: Node CLI previews and MP4 rendering. Verify timing, frames and audio. Do not download or install packages merely because this entry is listed.

tools.purpose: Optional gap-filler for existing Drive, Sheets, Calendar and Gmail connectors; does not provide Outlook access.
tools.control: CLI with separately authorized Google credentials. Prefer an already working connector when it can complete the job.

tools.purpose: Existing CMake/Ninja/vcpkg build kit. Use the configured kit instead of duplicating it.
tools.control: Use existing skse.doctor/configure/build/test capabilities when appropriate; inspect the receipt and actual artifacts.

tools.purpose: Optional style review for emails, descriptions and publishing copy. Keep creative prose and lyrics separate; preserve meaning, facts, figures and quotations.
tools.control: Adapt to the user's approved writing examples. A style check is not evidence of authorship.

tools.purpose: Reusable project-specific visual identity for videos, artwork and interfaces.
tools.control: Use a concise DESIGN.md-style brief when needed; do not install a service or add files to a cleaned project without a task need.
